title: Automation
subtitle: {{brand}} brand · rules, timers and the one-click bundles agents use

rules.heading: Workflow rules
rules.body: On each event, enabled rules run top to bottom. Drag to change the order.
rules.caption: Workflow rules, in the order they run
rules.emptyBody: A rule acts on a ticket when something happens to it: it is created, assigned, replied to.

timeBased.heading: Time-based rules
timeBased.body: Checked every few minutes over the tickets that match. Drag to change the order.
timeBased.caption: Time-based rules, in the order they run
timeBased.emptyBody: A time-based rule acts on tickets that have waited too long, such as awaiting customer for more than 3 days.
timeBased.footnote: A ticket is acted on once per match: closing it ends the match, and a customer reply resets time in status. What a time-based rule changes can set off workflow rules, up to depth 3.

list.loop: keep setting each other off. The depth guard stopped the loop on {{ticket}} today; change one rule's conditions so they do not all match.
list.footnote: A rule's actions can set off other rules, up to depth 3. A rule that would run a second time in the same chain is a cycle and is stopped before it acts. Every action shows in the ticket's activity log as rule:<id>.

confirm.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirm.body: The rule stops at once. Its runs stay in the execution log.

triggerHints.ticket_created: Runs once for each new ticket, whatever the channel.
triggerHints.ticket_updated: Runs whenever something about the ticket changes.
triggerHints.customer_replied: Runs when the customer sends a public reply.
triggerHints.agent_replied: Runs when a person on the desk sends a public reply. A rule's own reply does not count.
triggerHints.status_changed: Runs when the ticket moves to another status, including a close and a reopen.
triggerHints.assigned: Runs when the ticket's assignee or team changes.
triggerHints.tag_added: Runs when a tag is put on the ticket.
triggerHints.sla_warning: Runs when an SLA clock is about to run out.
triggerHints.sla_breached: Runs when an SLA clock has run out.
triggerHints.csat_received: Runs when the customer answers the satisfaction survey.

builder.name: Rule name
builder.order: Rules for the same event run in list order; this is rule {{position}}.
builder.scheduleNote: Checked on the rules cron queue at each interval over tickets that match. A ticket is acted on once per match: closing it ends the match, and a customer reply resets time in status.
builder.noConditions: No conditions: the rule runs on every ticket its event reaches.
builder.thenHint: Actions run in order. A change they make can set off other rules, up to depth 3.
builder.noCanned: No shared canned responses yet: add one under the Macros tab.
builder.countsHint: off by default. Off: the first-response clock keeps running until a person replies. Turn it on only when this reply really answers the customer.
builder.incomplete: Fill in every condition and action before saving.

testRun.heading: Test run
testRun.body: Tries this draft on a real ticket. Nothing is changed, sent or logged.
testRun.incomplete: Finish the rule's conditions and actions to test it.
testRun.failed: The test could not run. Try again.
testRun.notFound: No ticket {{ticket}} in the {{brand}} brand, or you cannot see it.
testRun.wouldNotRun: This rule would not run on {{ticket}}.
testRun.noConditions: It has no conditions, so it runs on every ticket.
testRun.nothingSetOff: Nothing else would be set off.

effects.unavailable: cannot be done on this ticket

testRun.followOnSkips: Would be skipped: {{reason}} does not match.
testRun.followOnStops: Would be stopped by the depth guard.

log.heading: Execution log
log.failed: the rule failed and its changes were rolled back

chain.depthTitle: Stopped at depth {{depth}}: a chain holds 3 rules at most
chain.again: {{rule}} would run again, so it was stopped before acting
chain.fourth: {{rule}} would have been rule 4, so it was stopped before acting
chain.kept: What the rules before it did is kept.
